source_stage_mapping.image_standardization: Plain full-image resizing replaces unsupported retinal cropping/local-color subtraction. Reference augmentation and publisher normalization are explicit choices.
source_stage_mapping.cnn_backbone: Eight models: two each of Inception-ResNet-v2, Inception-v4, SE-ResNeXt-50 and SE-ResNeXt-101, with trainable GeM and scalar regression head. EfficientNet substitution excluded.
source_stage_mapping.quadratic_weighted_kappa_qwk_loss: Smooth-L1 regression replaces unsupported differentiable-QWK training loss. QWK motivates final fixed ordinal thresholds, not the training objective.
source_stage_mapping.pre_training_fine_tuning: All pretrained backbone parameters train in stage one; an ensemble teacher builds three added target roles, and each own model continues ten epochs. Four-level grouping differs from five-level averaging labels.
source_stage_mapping.threshold_calibration: Fixed manually selected cuts 0.7,1.5,2.5,3.5 replace unsupported Nelder-Mead optimization. Equality convention is explicit.
